{{Quote|You want to see the moss or not?|Rodian to Han Solo|<ref name="TG" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who served [[Mawbo Kem]], the disreputable owner of [[Mawbo's Performance Hall]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TG" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> the Rodian was part of the hall's security detail during an auction. He ordered prospective buyers of the [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] ''[[Killik Twilight]]'' to be blindfolded before they were escorted to inspect the artwork. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], accompanied by his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], complained about the additional security measures, the Rodian asked whether he wanted to see the painting or not.<ref name="TG" />
